control_limits: Control columns use recorded budget application times over (t, t+h], including actuation timing unknown at t. They support system identification conditioned on the applied control, not a deployable forecast; that needs control inputs built from decision-time information plus an explicit actuation-delay assumption, with applications kept as evidence.

models.persistence: Current state; flows and cohorts extend the trailing rate from the window nearest the horizon (cohort outcomes use receipt-anchored resolved proxies).
models.ridge: Direct per-horizon ridge on standardized features plus the realized budget mean/end over (t, t+h] from recorded application times; nulls imputed with training means; clipped at zero.

splits.chronological: Train on rows whose label is fully known by the cut in every development run; evaluate rows at or after the cut. Scored per run and pooled.
splits.leave_one_run_out: Train on all other development runs; evaluate the whole held-out run.

caveats: 2 development capture(s) selected this design; they are not a test set.
Neighboring rows overlap, so n overstates independent evidence.
Ridge conditions on realized control (recorded application times), not on a plan known at t.
Persistence for cohort outcomes uses receipt-anchored proxies, not scheduled-arrival labels.
